text:
[Council File 26-1327; CD 13]
Motion (Soto-Martinez – Rodriguez) relative to the negotiation of a new non-profit lease with Urban Alchemy for the use of City-owned space at 1710 North Cherokee Avenue, Suite A, for the City’s Crisis and Incident Response through Community-led Engagement (CIRCLE) program.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Council is asked to direct the negotiation of a new non-profit lease with Urban Alchemy for City-owned space at 1710 North Cherokee Avenue, Suite A, used for the CIRCLE crisis response program.

locations.text: 1710 North Cherokee Avenue, Suite A, Los Angeles, CA
